description: Scenes with a purpose (owner, Oct 15, evening): the narrator's setup, the asker's opening and statement of purpose, the player's four replies with their stakes, the asker's answer and the close. Authored to calibrated patterns from ordinary American political and family talk (the text rule, Oct 15); no one's text is copied. Each piece serves every scene with its step and move: each use names the purpose it serves, so a line never leaks into a scene it does not fit; a follow that answers one reply names that reply's piece or move in `after`. A piece's bearing is the manner of its wording; the speaker's traits pull toward the bearings they favor. The director's exchange engine (src/director/scene-talk.ts) arranges the pieces by src/director/data/purpose-arcs.json.
